about: Senior Software Engineer and former CTO with 13+ years of game development experience, specializing in C++, Unity, C#, gameplay systems, ECS, client-server features, performance optimization, and developer tooling.

Most recently developed gameplay and meta systems for Homescapes (600M+ installs), contributing to 11 features and delivering engineering improvements including a 21–40% frame-rate increase and an hours-to-minutes UI integration workflow.

Experienced in large legacy codebases, backend systems, CI/CD, and technical leadership. Actively designs AI-assisted development workflows for specification, planning, implementation, validation, and code review.
Creator of Hidden Council, a Unity 6 grand-strategy game built with a custom C# ECS and structured AI-driven development process.
